records.subject: Getting started with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Mateo,

Thanks for trying Wrenfield. A quick tip: projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them -- so the first few minutes are usually spent creating one project and adding a few tasks to it.

Let us know how it goes.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

decisions.rationale: Project created day 1 [email:5584f681 context], but no invites and no milestone by day 6. Mateo replied engaged yet vague — "slow to get everyone set up but it's on our list this week" [email:9a227d40] — and no-showed the onboarding call [calendar:2cf69f1a]. Stated intent plus 8 days left gives moderate but below-even odds.

draft.subject: Re: How's the first week going?
draft.body:
Hi Mateo,

Thanks for the update — totally understand that getting everyone set up takes a bit of time.

When you're ready, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time if that's easier for a group.

Happy to jump on a short call this week and walk through it with you — just tell me a time that works and I'll send an invite.

Best,
Priya
